message.content: Fionnuala emphasizes the convenience of adjusting audio settings on the fly within the Control Center, particularly noting that it makes the process of switching between games and applications smoother. She highlights that this feature allows users to enhance their gaming experience without needing to pause the game. Specifically, Fionnuala mentions being able to "adjust audio settings on the fly without having to pause the game," which she describes as a "super convenient" feature. This capability enables gamers to fine-tune their sound preferences as needed, ensuring an optimal listening experience throughout the gameplay session.
